Geographies Served Programs Humanitarian Clothing Programme The Humanitarian Clothing initiative by CHAIIM Foundation serves as a flagship model of Chaiim Fabtech Pvt Ltd, aiming to empower women who have escaped or are at high risk of human trafficking. It provides dignified employment opportunities and operates as a mission-driven B2B lifestyle brand. The success of Chaiim Humanitarian Clothing goes beyond financial measures, striving to create long-term, sustainable social change. All profits generated are exclusively utilized for the well-being of women, including healthcare, education, vocational training, housing, and to expand the business, offering more women the chance to embrace freedom in the future. Rehabilitation Programme The Rehabilitation programme offered by CHAIIM Foundation focuses on providing essential services to women survivors. It includes healthcare support, counselling sessions, imparting basic life skills, facilitating education and vocational training, preparing them for employment opportunities, and ensuring access to safe housing. Milestones & Track Record Chaiim Foundation has been operating for over 10 years, establishing Chaiim Humanitarian Clothing as a garment production house in Mumbai to provide dignified employment opportunities for survivors. --> --> Leadership Team Keith Daniels Co-Founder & Managing Director Ramona Dsouza Cofounder & Program Director Demographics & Structure Organisation Strength None M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AABTC5759P Registration Number E-29881 CSR Form 1 CSR00002208 VO ID / Darpan ID MH/2019/0235422 --> 80G AABTC5759PF20213 12A AABTC5759PE20214 FCRA Not Available About Headquarters Mumbai, Maharashtra Since 2013 Demographies Served Women Girls --> Impact CHAIIM Foundation has made an impact by rehabilitating 195 survivors, reintegrating them into the community, and currently providing ongoing support to 35 survivors. Vision and Mission Chaiim Foundation's vision is to rehabilitate women survivors of human trafficking, while its mission is to promote the welfare of marginalized, poor, disadvantaged, and exploited individuals, focusing on reintegration, rehabilitation, and restoration.
